title: Solution Architect - IAM / Security
description:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with strong expertise in Banking Domain, Cloud Technologies (AWS/Azure), Microservices, API Integration, and Enterprise Architecture . The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and high-performing technology solutions for banking applications across Digital, Payments, Lending, Mortgages, Core Banking, Financial Crime, and Regulatory Reporting. 
 Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end technology solutions aligned with business and enterprise architecture goals. Create and present High-Level Design (HLD) documents. Gather and analyze business, functional, and non-functional requirements. Define architecture patterns, standards, and best practices. Design cloud-based solutions using AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments. Architect API-led, SOA, Microservices, and Event-Driven solutions. Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams. Identify architecture risks and recommend mitigation strategies. Ensure scalability, security, resilience, and performance of solutions. Provide technical leadership and guidance throughout project delivery. 
 Required Skills Strong Solution Architecture experience in Banking or Financial Services. Hands-on knowledge of AWS and/or Azure Cloud. Experience with Microservices, SOA, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), and API Integration. Understanding of DevOps practices and Agile delivery. Knowledge of Databases, Data Lakes, ETL, Streaming, and Analytics platforms. Familiarity with Enterprise Security and Operational Resilience concepts. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 Preferred Experience Candidates with prior experience as: Solution Architect Technical Architect Cloud Architect Digital Architect Data Architect Enterprise Architect Business Architect 
 Preferred Certifications AWS Solution Architect Certification Microsoft Azure Architect Certification 
 Experience: 10 to 15 years Location: Bangalore or Chennai Work Mode: All the days from office, In a month can avail 5 days of WFH

Key Skills: Security Architecture,Forgerock,Solution Design,Low Level Design,High Level Design,Identity Access Management,Federation Services,SAML
